title: Bazara a Ƙarƙashin Yashi
intro: A cikin tarihin Alƙur'ani, wani mutum mai haƙuri mai yawa ya fuskanci gwaji wanda zai karya zukatan masu ƙarfi. An kwace komai - dukiya, iyali, da lafiya. Duk da haka, daga cikin zurfin yanke ƙauna, an amsa addu'ar tawali'u ta hanyar da ba a zata ba. Za ku iya gane wannan ruhi wanda labarin maidowa ke maimaitawa tsawon shekaru?
clues: An gwada ni da wata jarabawa mai tsanani wadda ake tunawa da ita tsawon shekaru.
Na rasa duk abin da ya fi muhimmanci - dukiyata, 'ya'yana, da lafiyata.
Jikina ya cika da raunuka masu zafi, kuma kowa ya guje ni.
Cikin tsananin damuwa, na kira Allah, ina cewa Shaidan ya shafe ni da wahala da azaba.
Allah ya amsa min ya kuma umarce ni da in buga ƙasa da ƙafata.
Daga nan sai wani sanyin marmaro ya fito, Allah ya dawo da iyalina ya kuma ninka su a matsayin rahama.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
